Zone travel areas are shown on the map, with prices in the table below. You can buy your day and week Freedom Travelpass from First West of England bus drivers, and from most bus and railway ticket offices. You can buy a 1 day, 1 week or monthly ticket. A photocard is required for the monthly ticket, visit your local staffed station or bus ticket office for more details.
